name: WaitForMouseNode
label: Wait for Mouse
description: Suspends the execution of the flow until the mouse pointer changes to or from the specified cursor.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WaitAction
fields.label: Wait for Mouse Pointer To
fields.description: Specifies whether to wait until the mouse pointer becomes or stops being the specified type.

selectOptions.label: Become
selectOptions.description: Waits until the mouse pointer becomes the specified type.

selectOptions.label: Become Not
selectOptions.description: Waits until the mouse pointer stops being the specified type.

fields.name: CursorType
fields.label: Mouse Pointer
fields.description: The type of mouse pointer to wait for (e.g., Arrow, Hourglass).

selectOptions.label: Hand
selectOptions.description: Hand cursor typically used for links.

selectOptions.label: Help
selectOptions.description: Help cursor often used for tooltips.

selectOptions.label: I-Beam
selectOptions.description: Vertical bar cursor used in text fields.

selectOptions.label: Wait cursor
selectOptions.description: Hourglass cursor indicating a process is ongoing.

fields.name: FailWithTimeoutError
fields.label: Fail with Timeout Error
fields.description: If true, throws an error if the timeout is reached without the expected cursor change.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the cursor change.
